_about: Canonical exposure denominators for DC ward-level crash rate context. Population values are ward-level estimates on the current (2022) ward boundaries; land area is computed from official 2022 ward polygons by pipeline/snapshot.py. Edit population here when a newer authoritative count is published; do not hand-edit generated outputs.
_caveats: DC ward boundaries are redrawn each decade toward roughly equal population, so crashes-per-resident varies less across wards than crashes-per-area or crashes-per-road-mile. Treat per-capita ward comparison as weak and prefer per-area until road-mileage / VMT / trip denominators are added (see BACKLOG.md).

Per-ward population values are ~2022 ward-level estimates on the 2022 ward boundaries (consistent with the boundaries used to assign crashes to wards), compiled from DC Office of Planning / DC Health Matters figures via a secondary compilation; reconfirm each value against the DC OP per-ward tables before relying on these rates for final public analysis. The authoritative anchor is the 2020 U.S. Census, which recorded DC's total population at 689,545, and the 2021 ward redistricting balanced each ward toward ~86,193 residents (+/-5%).
Population is a 2022 estimate, not a same-year match to every crash window. Rates spanning multiple years use a fixed denominator and are approximate.
Land area is land only where the source distinguishes it; computed polygon area may include some non-land surface. It is an exposure proxy, not an official cadastral measure.

population.source_title: DC ward population estimates (2022 ward boundaries), anchored to the 2020 U.S. Census
population.source_agency: DC Office of Planning / DC Health Matters (per-ward estimates); U.S. Census Bureau (2020 decennial total)
population.note: Ward-level population estimates on the current (2022) ward boundaries, used as exposure denominators consistent with the 2022-boundary crash ward assignment. Per-ward values are compiled from DC Office of Planning / DC Health Matters demographic data via a secondary compilation and should be reconfirmed against the DC OP per-ward tables; the 2020 U.S. Census recorded DC's total population at 689,545 and the 2021 ward redistricting balanced each ward toward ~86,193 residents (+/-5%).

land_area.method: Square miles computed from official ward polygons by pipeline/snapshot.py using a local equirectangular projection at DC latitude; written into data/crash-summary.json at build time.
land_area.note: Values are emitted into crash-summary.json, not stored here, so they always match the polygon snapshot used for the build.
